description.content: Endpoints for working with referral codes: look up a code and its associated reward, or apply a code to a referred account. For background on what referral codes are, see the Referral Code Overview.

**Deprecated.** Use the Open Endpoint *Lookup a referral code* instead.

Returns a referral code along with the referrer's name and the reward the code unlocks.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

Applies a referral code to the specified account and user, marking them as referred by the code's owner.

Requires a [write token](https://integrations.impact.com/impact-brand/reference/api-open-endpoints) or an API key. This is an [Open Endpoint](https://integrations.impact.com/impact-brand/reference/api-open-endpoints) and is disabled by default. Contact support to enable open endpoints.

(Required) The referral code to apply to the user's account.
(Required) The account to apply the referral code to. This account will be marked as referred by the owner of the code.
(Required) The user to apply the referral code to. This user will be marked as referred by the owner of the code.
